BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me about the progress that is being made in the field of robotics? ASSISTANT:

Robotics has been making great progress in recent years. The development of advanced AI technologies have made robots increasingly capable and robust. The applications of robotics have grown significantly in many areas such as healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, and education. There is now a growing interest in the wider public to explore the potential of robotics for social good. As a result, many organizations are forming to explore the development of ethical robots that can serve society.
